dialect: One British-spelling English corpus for all physical keyboard profiles; never infer dialect from hardware.
selection: Manually selected everyday vocabulary, verified against pinned source; source tier is commonness grouping, not a precise frequency ranking.
licenseScope: Derived word list only, British/default regions, maximum tier 50; no Australian data, >80 word lists, source database or POS metadata is shipped. Preserve ESDB-NOTICE.txt in distributed copies/supporting notices.
buildNote: Upstream combine.py emitted unmatched compound-entry warnings while building the pinned database. Every selected word passed membership in its generated extract; no warning was suppressed or used as a word source.
